## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/motivation.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Audio DSP / Streaming optimization

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All unit and integration tests pass locally (`cargo test --workspace`).
- [ ] Clippy checks pass with zero warnings (`cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings`).
- [ ] Formatting is verified (`cargo fmt --check`).
- [ ] Relevant documentation has been updated.
